policy: Only exact existing source findings listed with reasons are retained. New findings block the regression check. Real contrast/focus/reduced-motion/overflow failures are never accepted here.

findings.evidence: dash "—" in copy
findings.fix: A comma, a colon, a full stop or parentheses; never a dash
findings.reason: A mathematical range or missing-value mark preserves quantified data meaning; retained under the locked Forewise system rather than rewritten as decorative copy.

findings.evidence: <em>/<i> inside <h1>
findings.fix: Roman headers; emphasis via weight or accent
findings.reason: The approved Forecast Horizon signature uses a complete multi-word serif second line, not an accidental isolated italic word; identity is locked by owner instruction.

findings.evidence: eyebrow "BUSINESS FORECASTING / PRODUCT …" before <h1>
findings.fix: Cut it; the heading already says this (craft.md § 7 has twelve other openings)
findings.reason: Existing Fieldnotes/Horizon section labels are part of the approved layout and identity. Readability was improved without deleting content to satisfy a house-style ban.

findings.evidence: two sticky top:0 elements: .data-table-scroll thead, .h-table-scroll thead + .…
findings.fix: Offset the second sticky by banner height
findings.reason: Static analysis conflates a table-local sticky header with the mobile control bar in a different scroll context. Actual rendered checks and overflow tests cover the resulting geometry.
